description: This file contains Python classes and functions for reading and processing breakpad dump files, specifically for Linux and Android platforms, including symbol generation and dump parsing.

classes.name: DumpReaderMultipart
classes.description: Base class for Linux and Android breakpad dump reader, handling dump parsing, symbol generation, and dump analysis.

classes.name: DumpReaderLinux
classes.description: Linux-specific implementation of dump reader, providing binaries to symbolize.

classes.name: DumpReaderAndroid
classes.description: Android-specific implementation of dump reader, providing binaries to symbolize.

methods.name: check_is_functional
methods.description: Checks if breakpad tools are available and functional.

methods.name: _get_pid_from_dump
methods.description: Extracts process ID from a dump file.

methods.name: _get_stack_from_dump
methods.description: Generates and retrieves the stack trace from a dump file.

methods.name: _read_dump
methods.description: Reads and parses dump file content.

methods.name: _check_breakpad_tools_available
methods.description: Verifies presence of required breakpad tools.

methods.name: _generate_breakpad_symbols_if_necessary
methods.description: Generates breakpad symbols if not already generated.

methods.name: _binaries_to_symbolize
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, returning list of binaries to symbolize.
